implementation_summary: Added automatic backup before overwrite in TodoStorage.save(). Before atomic rename, if the target file exists, it is copied to a .bak file using shutil.copy2 to preserve permissions. Only 1 backup is kept (no rotation).
acceptance_criteria_met: save() creates .bak file before overwriting when original exists
Backup file has same permissions as original
Backup rotation keeps only 1 backup file
New file save does not create .bak
risks: Backup creation adds a small I/O overhead on each save
If original file is very large, backup copy could temporarily use extra disk space
limitations: Does not implement load from backup - this could be added in future if needed
